params.name: Shrike 2076
params.note: CONCEPT, generated by scripts/shapes/concepts/shrike-2076.mjs (edit that, not this). The Stuka fifty years on: an optionally crewed single-seat dive striker. A chined hull with the drooping beak kept and a targeting turret under it; one jet in the tail fed by a chin intake where the radiator hung; a gold-filmed canopy; the inverted gull wing, cranked and swept, with the slatted dive brakes under it, flaps and ailerons; the bomb inside a bay between the knees on a trapeze; fixed talon legs with a cell broadcaster on each where the siren was, which pushes the dive alert to every tablet in the target zone; a big swept fin, a swept tailplane, ventral strakes. The diveBrake channel swings the brakes, opens the bay and lowers the bomb. A variant of the divebomber mesh, worn as the Shrike 2076 factory edition.
